verdict.rationale: A company-registry e-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows, such as automated annual-return filings or compliance-deadline jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt 403 probes for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, so there is no evidence of any scheduling capability. The robots.txt walls show that nothing was fetched; they do not show that scheduling is absent.
